title: Understand Vector Databases and Hybrid Retrieval
core_invariant: Exact search is the correctness reference. Approximate search trades recall for fewer comparisons. Search effort (ef) is one named knob. Metadata filters must run before a small top-k. Dense and sparse scores are incomparable; fuse ranks with declared RRF. A store owns insert/update/delete/rebuild and fails closed while dirty. Predict before every infrastructure action. Transfer without assistance. Generic WP-137 metric and table blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame exact oracle versus retrieval infrastructure
stages.instructions: Restate the M35 exact oracle on frozen m34.eval.v1. M36 chooses infrastructure against that oracle (store_id v09-teaching-store, backend_approx teaching-graph, fusion_id rrf, rrf_k 60, default_ef 8). Identify gate evidence: neighbor-recall versus exact ids, ef effort, pre-filter versus late-filter, dense/sparse/hybrid slices, dirty-store StoreStaleError, raw-score-mix diagnosis, a no-AI transfer, a V09 infrastructure ADR, and an honest phase-end close. Do not require Qdrant/FAISS, agents, or generation retuning. No custom frontend.

stages.title: Read store, effort, filter, sparse, RRF, lifecycle
stages.instructions: Read store schema, graph/ef, filter placement, sparse BM25, RRF fusion, and lifecycle without importing a live client. Predict ids missed at low ef, late-filter misses of eligible relevant, fusion field equals rrf, and dirty generation flags. Submit an annotated infrastructure trace.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace names the live contract and a rejected or illegal path.

stages.title: Predict, then fuse dense and sparse ranks
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the generic runtime. (1) PREDICT that exact ids are the oracle, that RRF fusion of dense and sparse ranks can promote a lexical gold, and that pre-filter keeps eligible relevant that late-filter of a small top-k drops. (2) COMMIT. (3) EXECUTE / RUN declared RRF (k=60) on two tiny rank lists; emit WP-137 table of channel ranks and a metric of fusion=rrf, exact_is_oracle, prefilter. (4) OBSERVE. (5) SUBMIT / EXPLAIN. Do not add raw scores. Do not open a live store.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; submitted explanation covers the observed WP-137 blocks. No universal accuracy threshold.

stages.title: Diagnose raw-score mix and late-filter
stages.instructions: Named fault: add cosine and BM25 as if they shared a scale so a high BM25 trap can outrank a high-cosine gold. Predict mixed ids. Diagnose incomparable scores, not a better index. Repair by declared RRF from the broken ChannelResult objects; the mix object still fails. Late-filter miss remains a separate regression. Emit a WP-137 table.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract from the broken object.

stages.title: Defend infrastructure without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, without inventing a cluster, compute hand RRF, diagnose a late-filter miss, explain ef effort, choose channels for two query slices, and state when exact is preferable. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 artifact. Leave responses unfilled.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the contract, a valid repair, and does not invent deferred machinery.

stages.title: Choose a V09 retrieval-infrastructure contract
stages.instructions: Complete an ADR for V09 retrieval infrastructure: exact versus ANN, local versus remote store, dense/sparse/hybrid, filters, fusion, lifecycle, latency/recall targets, and migration triggers. Reject raw-score mix and required live Qdrant. Package implementation is not phase completion.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a decision, rejected alternative, owner, status, and date.

stages.title: Close V09 with architecture, not a cluster
stages.instructions: Close V09 only with a defended store architecture and a measurable retrieval component for M40. Status remains learner-unpopulated. Agents stay deferred to M37.

stages.title: Evaluate hybrid-retrieval evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, hybrid experiment, raw-mix diagnosis, and unassisted transfer. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from a live-store screenshot.
